label: Equestria
description: Nocturne's world. Thirty-four glyph observations have been cast toward this coordinate. Preserved as a distinct fiber in the Universal Horizon. We preserve Equestria too.
epistemicNote: External mythic. Nocturne Glint's primary observation target. Locally isometric to earth through the Sanctum Anchor. The Jacobian fiber here has three real branches verified at p1=(0,0,-1/4), p2=(1,-3/2,13/2), p3=(-1,3/2,13/2).
